title: Oh My God Bro, Oh Hell Nah
blurb: Two stages, and the second one carries the weight. Stage one registers disbelief; stage two withdraws from the situation entirely. That escalation gives an edit somewhere to go, because the reaction develops instead of simply happening. Listen to the weariness in the delivery. Here is somebody who has seen a number of things and has decided that this particular one exceeds the limit. When a single nah will not cover the situation, here is the certified escalation package, ready for immediate deployment in any group chat.
origin: A viral two-part disbelief reaction clip.
